In a castle game, these propositions are about the player:

- p: "the player has the silver key"
- q: "it is night"
- r: "the player wears the guard's coat"

## Task 1 · Truth values

Right now, p = T, q = F and r = T.

a) Find the values of ¬q, p ∧ q and p ∨ q.

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

b) The gate opens when p ∧ (q ∨ r). Does it open now? Show each step.


{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

c) A guard writes the rule without brackets: p ∧ q ∨ r. Find a case
(values of p, q, r) where his rule opens the gate but the right rule does
not.

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

## Task 2 · The rules in code

a) Write the condition in C#: "the guards attack when it is night and the
player does not wear the coat".

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

b) The rule of the game is "if the player wears the coat, then it is
night". Write the C# condition that finds a bug in this rule. For which
values of r and q is it true?

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}
